program.name: Joint Flow Volume
program.subject: Yoga flow
program.blurb: Long yoga flows joint by joint: hips and knees, the spine, then shoulders and wrists.
program.about: Yoga that moves each joint through all it can do. Hip circles, shin-box and lunges for the hips and knees; cat-cow, spinal waves and twists for the spine; wrist rocks, threading the needle and shoulder openers for the upper body. Three days rotate and each ends with a rest. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings harder poses.
